appearance.subtle: Something pale flickers across their eyes when they blink.
appearance.obvious: A milky membrane slides sideways across their eyes when the light shifts, and they do not seem to notice doing it.
appearance.extreme: Their eyes are permanently filmed over in the dark, flat and reflective as an animal caught in headlights. Looking at them is difficult.

description: A translucent second lid that slides across when the light drops. The dark opens up completely. So does everyone staring at you.
drawbacks: Extremely visible when it is up
name: Night Membrane
